prompts.name: debug
prompts.prompt: Use the attached approved main screen as the visual STYLE REFERENCE. Create one separate high fidelity desktop screen for this SAME Piper robot laboratory workbench, 1920x1080 landscape, flat front screenshot only, no device mockup or browser chrome. Match its light white/cool gray background, strong black Chinese typography, restrained blue accent, subtle borders, rounded cards, and sophisticated precise layout. ALL user-facing interface words predominantly SIMPLIFIED CHINESE, never English sentences. Keep only proper technical names such as Piper, D455, Dabai, YOLO, TCP, CAN, J1–J6, TF and actual file paths as needed. Buttons for planning and execution must say 规划 and 执行. No emoji, use thin monochrome line icons. Fixed left sidebar (~184px): brand Piper 工作台 and exactly SIX navigation items 抓取, 调试, 连接, 标定, 图片采集, 日志; no duplicate homepage. Persistent top bar device health chips 机械臂, D455, Dabai, YOLO, MoveIt, 传送带 and buttons 待机位, 观察位, red 急停. Small note 方案预览 · 示例数据. No added safety gates, approval forms, prerequisite checklists, interlocks, permission dialogs, or global disabled overlays. Fit entire content on screen with legible labels and deliberate spacing. Numbers and data are illustrative only. Show the 调试 screen, active sidebar 调试. Page title 调试与参数. Subtabs 运动调试 (active), 抓取参数, 相机与检测, 标定文件, 示教与放置点, 高级. Main layout: large left-center real RViz-style view of BLACK SIX-AXIS PIPER with parallel gripper on a LIGHT GRID, gray conveyor beside it. A translucent BLUE target robot ghost and TCP six degree of freedom interactive marker at the gripper with small red green blue translation arrows and rotation rings. Header 运动规划, small coordinate label 基坐标系. A compact control row beneath scene: 读取当前位置, blue 规划, blue 执行, 停止, 清除预览. Clearly distinguish 实际机械臂 and 目标姿态 via two small legend swatches. Right card 目标关节角 with six horizontal sliders J1 to J6, each with numeric degree spinbox, visually polished and evenly spaced. Below, TCP 目标位姿 fields X Y Z in 毫米 and 滚转 俯仰 偏航 in 度. Card 规划参数 with sliders 速度比例 55% and 加速度比例 55%, small subtitle 仅用于手动规划. Bottom status strip 规划成功 · 轨迹预览已更新, 路径时长 2.4 秒. Small separate inline note 拖动只修改目标，点击执行才运动. Keep the full native robot interaction credible, no fantasy holograms.

revisions.name: connection-recovery
revisions.prompt: Edit the attached Chinese Piper workbench connection screen. Preserve its light white/gray/blue visual design, six-item left navigation, top global health/status strip and emergency button, existing component cards, and 16:9 screenshot layout. Add a prominent outlined action button labeled 碰撞后恢复 near 一键启动全部 at top right. Add a compact expandable panel named 碰撞保护恢复 with visible sequential steps 暂停任务 → 停止旧 T1 → CAN 激活 → 机械臂激活 → 重启 T1, a short helper text 恢复后保持暂停，手动开始抓取 and an action 查看恢复日志. This is an operator-initiated recovery workflow, never automatic re-enabling. Do not add permission checklists or safety interlocks. Show step progress and original output within existing bottom console, with a mock message 恢复命令已完成，等待机械臂反馈. Correct the previous generated mock labels: YOLO model should read fruits12.pt, action program should read auto_sorting_action.py, camera calibration path should read config/calibration/ (not config/tf.yaml), conveyor serial baudrate must be 115200 (not 1152000). Camera resolutions 640×480, D455 30 帧/秒, Dabai 15 帧/秒. All ordinary interface text in simplified Chinese. Real commands can remain literal: can_activate.sh can0 1000000 and cansend can0 123#1122334455667788. Keep top note 方案预览 · 示例数据. Fit everything with good spacing; no modal, no device mockup. Output only the revised one-screen design image.
